exact_items: Recommended minimum contract additions: add execution_role to runtime handoff bundle, attempt.started, attempt_record, worker identity/detail inspectors; add operational_identity? to attempt_record, operational receipt/bridge records, and relevant tool/runtime artifact payloads.

Candidate fixes: make execution_role part of the canonical attempt packet in Contracts_V0.md and storage-plan.md; define operational_identity as a separate optional field family for receipts, artifacts, and side-effect-bearing attempt/tool records.

Impacted docs include Orchestrator_Page.md, Run_Graph_View.md, Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md, usage-feature.md; contradictions note Orchestrator_Page.md lacks execution_role or operational target context and usage-feature.md has no place for execution-role disclosure.

Tool events, runtime artifacts, receipts, and usage want one shared attribution packet, but the docs still describe them as separate identity worlds; storage-plan.md is strongest anchor with attempt_record.provider_attempt_ref?, orchestrator.receipt.{run_id}.{attempt_id}, and usage_record bridging Source Control / GitHub Actions / Docker / Kubernetes / Usage.
Recommended unified attribution packet should be available to tool.invoked, tool.denied, runtime_artifact.*, runtime receipts, usage_record / cost_usage, and relevant evidence / trace views.
